<parameter name="file_text">#!/usr/bin/env python3

from collections import defaultdict

# Read the revelation text
text = open('revelation.txt', 'r').read().strip()

print(f"Text length: {len(text)} characters\n")

best_passage = ""
best_count = 0
min_length = 40

# Try increasing lengths - the max count can only stay same or decrease
for length in range(min_length, len(text) + 1):
    substrings = defaultdict(int)
    
    # Count all substrings of this length
    for i in range(len(text) - length + 1):
        substring = text[i:i+length]
        substrings[substring] += 1
    
    # Find the maximum count at this length
    if not substrings:
        break
        
    max_count_at_length = max(substrings.values())
    
    # If the max count decreased, we can stop (no longer passage can have higher count)
    if max_count_at_length < best_count:
        break
    
    # Update best if we found higher count or same count (which means longer)
    if max_count_at_length >= best_count:
        best_count = max_count_at_length
        candidates = [s for s, c in substrings.items() if c == max_count_at_length]
        best_passage = candidates[0]
        
        if length <= 50 or length % 10 == 0:  # Print progress
            print(f"Length {length}: max count = {best_count}")

print(f"\n=== RESULT ===")
print(f"Passage length: {len(best_passage)} characters")
print(f"Occurrences: {best_count}\n")
print(f"Passage:\n{best_passage}")
